ai_summary: Aarvi Encon achieved robust H1-FY27 operational income growth (+7.4% Y-o-Y), fueled by new client acquisitions and substantial order bookings that enhance future revenue visibility. However, Q2-FY27 profitability suffered a material negative impact, with EBITDA and Profit After Tax declining sharply by over 25% year-over-year and even more steeply quarter-on-quarter due to contracting margins. This significant deterioration in Q2 margins, despite overall H1 top-line performance, presents a red flag regarding potential underlying cost pressures or pricing challenges.
